fun game you get to go up to a goon that says "oh yeah and what are you gonna do with that?" and then beat his head in with a lead pipe. and they are voiced by Gianni Matrgano wich makes it so much funnier.

Fallen Aces is amazing. At the time of my writing this, there are only 5 levels but they are incredible. It feels like a genuine immersive sim, and it has a great story that I was thoroughly engaged with. …

If my computer can't run the game at launch, that's on me. If I can run the game at launch, but the developers change the system requirements when they release episode 2 and it doesn't work any more, that's their fault.
关卡设计还行吧，但这游戏EA了两年完成度只有1/3，谨慎购买。我会在游戏出全之后再考虑购买。
漫画画风超级棒 对这游戏一秒坠入爱河 配乐和一些小互动都特别有意思 一股子上世纪老旧的味道 10/10 Perfect！
